text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Kiseki behind the school building,
holding her smartphone.
choice_data_list: (Hm? Is she on a call with someone?)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hah, look who's talkin' smack... Ya ready to pay the piper, huh...?
—Get a taste of my brass knuckles!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, no, that's not quite it...
It needs more of a badass vibe... A sharper punchline...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching Kiseki's serious expression, it suddenly clicked. Come to think of it,
something similar happened back when she was drawing a battle manga—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Bloom, run wild, Ring of the Heavens. Inscribe the One beyond Zero.
I hereby record the Genesis—"Rikka: Izayoi"!!
choice_data_list: W-What's going on all of a sudden...?
W-What brought this on all of a sudden...?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! Sorry about that, Trainer!
A great line popped into my head, so I was recording a voice memo!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Though... why does this always happen?
When the idea strikes, I think, "Am I a genius or what!!?"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yet when I listen back later, I almost always go,
"...Yeah, totally unusable!" It's a mystery, a complete mystery!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In short, what she'd just said was simply lines for a manga.
Wondering what kind of work her new project would be, I left the scene.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I saw Kiseki at a clothing store that sells
school uniforms, chatting with a clerk. As I watched—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Wooooow~! I knew about long and short gakuran jackets,
but there are semi-shorts too?! The historical context is so fascinating!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Yup, I should buy a few for reference material!
Alright then, could I get that long gakuran, and... do you have bontans?
choice_data_list: (Going this far just for manga research... Impressive.)
(Going this far just for manga research... Amazing.)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I see! So your bond isn't just about being friends,
it's more like a family! That's how it feels, right?!

text_block_list.name: Shaved-Line Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, pretty much. ...Though hearin' you say it
out loud like that makes me kinda embarrassed...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah~! Yes, that's it! So fiery! A bond deeper than mere friendship!
That passion is definitely the core charm of this genre!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Could you tell me more?
Next, about your rivalry dynamics with other teams!
choice_data_list: (She's really leaning in, even with delinquents...)
(She's really diving in, even with delinquents...)

text_block_list.name: Shaved-Line Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Those jerks from Rampage Racing just rolled up
to trash our turf! Not on my watch... We settle this on the track! Kiseki, you're with us!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! Leave it to me!
I'm part of Sukubion now, too!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Like hell we'll sit quiet while they disrespect the crew.
Let's show those chumps what we're made of! Charge!!
choice_data_list: (...Isn't she getting a bit too absorbed into the role?!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shortly after, at the freestyle race track...
I spotted Kiseki surrounded by rough-and-tumble students!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
"Hey. Did you really draw this?" "Hah? You better not be pullin' our leg!"
"Gimme that already! It's my turn, dammit!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no! Take turns, take turns!
Hold on a second, will you~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Did Kiseki get too close to the delinquent crowd?!
—Rushing over to them in a panic, I raised my voice.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
............Huh?
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Nobody's in any danger here~!
They're just taking turns reading my manga on the tablet!
choice_data_list: I-Is that what this is...? Sorry.
O-Oh, that's what was happening...? My bad.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Do you want to read it too, Trainer?
Created with everyone's help—"Pleased to Meet You, Outsider"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a story about a protagonist with no place to belong at school
who discovers a true home among delinquent companions—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight! Hell yeah!
...Ehehe!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The work was grounded in realistic, vivid details,
all made possible because of Kiseki's earnest, dedicated research.
choice_data_list: You take manga incredibly seriously, don't you?
You really put your whole heart into manga, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yes! Well, of course I do!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Because I want every single reader to say, "This is amazing!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I've read countless manga in my life!
And all the works that truly resonated with me carried immense passion and drive.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That sheer determination to make the reader go, "This is awesome!"
...So I refuse to make even the slightest compromise. Because—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That's exactly the kind of manga I want to draw, too!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I thought I understood before, but once again,
I was reminded of just how profound her love for manga truly was.
